expected_controls.content:
Enter nil for any setting you don't want to use.
Get Promotions From Partner: Enter yes to get promotions from your partner, otherwise you will get promotions from the NPC guild master.
Messages:  Enter yes if you wish to receive feedback about what the script is currently doing.
Lnet message partner: Enter yes to Lnet message your partner when their help is required.
Entering yes for lnet messages requires you to trust this script.
Auto check in:  Enter yes for script to automatically check in when guild fees are due.
Do work in other guilds:  Enter yes to travel to nearby guilds if necessary for certain tasks. This includes audience reps.
Currently only works if you're doing tasks out of Icemule, Landing or Solhaven guilds.
Weapon:  Name of your weapon. This is used in several guild reps.
Offhand:  Name of your offhand weapon/shield.
Main Disarm Weapon: Weapon to be used for disarm partner tasks and critter disarm tasks.
Warning: This weapon will be knocked to the ground during certain disarm partner reps, do not use a weapon you don't want to risk losing.
Use Boosts: Enter 'yes' to use Guild Profession Boost (if needed) before finishing task.

Enter exit in Critter rooms field to exit script on critter tasks so you can do them manually.
Critter rooms:  List all rooms of area you want to look for critters in; example 1,2,3
No spaces after commas
Critter names:  Name of critters to look for, example: critterA|critterB
Resting room:  Room number to rest in when out of stamina.
Pre rest commands:  Command to enter after arriving at Resting room number.

Enter nil for any setting you don't want to use.
Batter Barriers Weapon:  Enter name of weapon you use for Batter Barriers tasks.
Locker room:  Room number where curtain or opening to locker is found.
When doing Batter Barriers tasks the script will check locker for battering weapon if not found on character.
Container to stow weapon:  Name of container to stow weapon for tasks where it's not needed.
Critter boxes room: Room number of room where you have critter boxes waiting for you to batter.
If above setting is used your character won't pick up boxes when finished with critter batter box tasks.
Low health script:  Name of script to run while low on health.
Example you could create a script that eats acantha leaf until full health.
Haste script:  Similar to above; name of script to run when haste not active on character.
The script could run you to a wizard who casts haste on you.

Enter nil for any setting you don't want to use.
Critter Stow Weapon: Enter yes to stow your weapon when tackling critters. Having a weapon in hand gives a -10 penalty.
Critter Stow Offhand: Enter yes to stow your offhand when tackling critters. Having something in offhand gives a -10 penalty.
Critter Stance: Enter stance you want to be in when tackling critters. Offensive stance gives highest bonus to successfully tackling.
Enter one of the following for stance:  Offensive, Advance, Forward, Neutral, Guarded, Defensive
Note: Script will always put you in defensive stance and grab your weapon and offhand when looking for a critter.
Enter yes for any task you wish to automatically trade in.

command: R4_BROWSER=1 R4_TRACE_DIR=docs/webui-redux/r4-traces rspec script/support/r4_pilot_spec.rb --example saves\ corrected\ madwarrior\ through\ an\ explicit\ submission
